name: Jonathan Thompson

events.title: Marriage
events.description: Married Elizabeth, daughter of James Havens of Shelter Island.

bioAdditions: 3rd cousin 8 times removed via John Thompson and 4th cousin 7 times removed via Bull Smith through his mother Mary Gardiner (Bull -> Richard 2d -> Nathaniel -> Mary Smith -> Mary Gardiner -> Jonathan) (S1). Children: David, George W., Jonathan, Dr. Abraham Gardiner, Mary (wife of Samuel Buel Gardiner, 10th Lord of Gardiner's Island) and Elizabeth.

sources.citation: W. S. Pelletreau (ed.), Records of the Town of Smithtown (1898), Appendix (archive.org full text, scans recordsoftownofs00smitrich and recordstownsmit00pellgoog), App. p. 470

researchLogEntry: Round 4: dates, marriage and both routes verified in Pelletreau.
